action_taken: District RRT investigated. Water samples coliform positive. Pipeline repair and super-chlorination executed.
Stool culture confirmed Vibrio cholerae Ogawa. Overhead tank disinfected, halogen tablets distributed.
Post-monsoon runoff inundation. Mobile medical camp setup, ORS packets and zinc syrup distributed.
Door-to-door case search conducted. Well chlorinated. Public awareness on safe boiling of water conducted.
Drinking water pipeline leakage detected near drainage. Municipal water line isolated and repaired.
Contaminated borewell water supply sealed. Alternative tanker water supply arranged.
Northeast Monsoon localized water-logging in ward. Metrowater chlorination boosted to 2.0 ppm.
Temple festival feast mass gathering water supply contaminated. Bleaching powder added to supply well.
